# RentalNow

> RentalNow is a phone web app (PWA) for bike, scooty and car rental shops in India. It handles bookings, a single fleet list, deposits, WhatsApp bills and the owner's daily earnings. It installs from the browser and works offline. 14-day free trial, no card needed. Made by the HisaabNow team in Noida, India.

Pricing changes, so it is not listed here. See https://app.hisaabnow.com/Rent/ for current plans.

## Software pages
- [Car rental software](https://app.hisaabnow.com/Rent/car-rental-software): for self-drive car rental. Km-based rates with odometer at pickup and return, driving licence number required at booking, deposits tracked separately.
- [Bike and scooty rental software](https://app.hisaabnow.com/Rent/bike-rental-software): overtime charges, deposits, vehicles with expired PUC or insurance can be blocked, WhatsApp bill at return.
- [Vehicle rental software](https://app.hisaabnow.com/Rent/vehicle-rental-software): for shops that rent both bikes and cars.
- [Install RentalNow](https://app.hisaabnow.com/Rent/install.html)

## Free tool
- [Rental agreement generator](https://app.hisaabnow.com/Rent/rental-agreement-generator): fill in the details and download a ready-to-sign car or bike rental agreement as a PDF.
